Card Q&A.q: I don’t have [Eyesmon: Scatter Mode] in my trash. If I trash both this card and [Eyesmon: Scatter Mode] in my hand with an effect, can I play this card?

Effect: When you trash this card in your hand using one of your effects, if [Eyesmon: Scatter Mode] is in your trash, you may play this card without paying its memory cost.
[Your Turn] For each [Eyesmon: Scatter Mode] in your trash, this Digimon gets +2000 DP.
